_comment: Copy to genesys/agents.json (git-ignored) and use real mailboxes: each agent receives a Genesys Cloud invitation to set a password. Plus-addressing (you+wx84-menlo@...) works well. All agents join the group WX-84 Agents and with it the queue WX-84 Weather Desk; what each one sees in WX-84 is set in data/users.txt. roles are Genesys Cloud role names granted in the home division; missing roles are skipped with a warning.
